svg.title: One sea-ice step: algorithm flow
svg.desc: Flow chart of one thermodynamic sea-ice step in PlaSiC, with the formulas, branch conditions and C names of every stage: forcing and snowfall; surface temperature and melt energy; conduction; snow melt and flooding; the ice energy ledger; compactness, thickness cap and ice mask; the ocean step (3-D ocean, then slab) that returns the ocean-to-ice flux used one step later; and the fields handed back to the atmosphere.
